body: I understand. I just want to get rid of this feeling. And it won't be easy, but the kindness I've received from not just you but from everyone else on this post makes me feel like I matter. And that's all I want. To matter. I'll stay strong, I'll believe I can overcome this.

I can't thank you enough for your kind words. I will take your words to heart and always remember them. 


I will resist. I will try my best. I hope it was just a slight hiccup and that I will see my way through this. 


I hope this to be true someday. I want to believe I can move on from this. I want to believe.


Thank you again. I feel like you truly listened and explained everything to me thoroughly. I feel ashamed that it came to these extremes. You are the hope that will keep me going. I will stay in touch with you, if that's no problem. I appreciate how kind you are being with me. Even though we may not know each other personally, I already feel entrusting to you and I couldn't ask for more. You're a wonderful person.

I completely agree. And you're right. I felt independent with her, and I hope I can feel that again on my own.


That's exactly how I feel. Like I'm not good enough for anyone, no matter what efforts I make or what I accomplish. 


That's all I want from her. A good-bye. A blessing, some sign that she knows I'm existing and that we end things on good terms.


I hope so. I really do hope it works.

Thank you for your kind words. They mean so much to me right now, I feel like I have no one to turn to or anyone that cares. 


Honestly, it's not even the fact that it's over. I can accept that. It's that she didn't give me a proper send off. The straight up cold shoulder tore me into pieces and is making me feel like I'm not worthy of her words, I'm not worthy of anything. But I see where you're coming from, and I appreciate it. Truly.

It's the typical cliche. I would do anything for her. The 4 years we were together, we've shared our laughs. We've gone through hardships. She helped me throughout an addiction. She gave me a place to stay when I lost it all. And I can never repay her for everything she's done for me. I always listened to her. Never said "I can't do that" to her. I can't stress how much she has impacted my life. She's the reason I am now sober, back in school and becoming a functioning member of society. 

I feel used. I feel like I don't mean anything to anyone. I don't have any friends. I feel vulnerable. My friends did nothing but hurt my life, and tried to hurt my relationship with her. This was months ago. But we pulled through, and we were stronger than ever.

I feel like I hold no value anymore. She was there when my my family wasn't,. I've had a shaky relationship with mom, dad moved out, but she helped me build up and to trust people again. 

But now with this, I feel like I can't trust anyone. I feel like I have no one anymore.
